open: Station vs mall: only units OSM puts in the station hall (level 0, near the platform passage) are included. Excluded as Bruun's Galleri or outside: H&M, Name It, Rituals, 3, Thiele, Bruuns Apotek, Silvan, Jack & Jones etc. (Bruun's Galleri), Café Opera and Café Stiften (west of the station on OSM, not confirmed in the station), the 7-Eleven at Banegårdspladsen 6 (separate 24 h store) and OSM 7-Eleven n10807944510 outside the building.
Which OSM 7-Eleven node is 'Århus H' and which 'Århus H IC' is matched by hours/position only.

Lifts and escalators: OSM gives no levels or platform refs for the four lifts and six platform escalators; which lift serves which perron (1: spor 2/3, 2: spor 4/5, 3: spor 6/7) is not settled. Wikipedia says 4 platforms/8 tracks; the register has 3 perrons (tracks 2-7).
OSM platforms (w515037672, w515037673) carry no refs.
Hours missing for Dunkin'; McDonald's, Joe & The Juice and Smarteyes are OSM only. Toilet price not stated.
Level names as signposted not found.
No published station plan (DSB, Banedanmark, Midttrafik/FynBus/NT) found on 2026-10-30; DSB publishes access only as present/absent lines. Level heights: no source measures them.
